verdicts.reason: A is just the original banner shrunk and letterboxed into the square: there are big empty white bands above and below it, and the curator line and 'Подпишись' button are too small to read. Nothing was rearranged, but at least the design is intact. B has collapsed: the headline 'Fashion фотография' and the brown background are gone, the two photos are tiny cropped slivers, and the decorative circles and swooshes are scattered at random. The curator text now floats above everything as the top element, and the CTA sits on a broken half-circle, so the design is unusable.
